candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Vestník verejného obstarávania (official Slovak public procurement journal)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory journal where all SK contracting authorities must publish contract notices and award results (oznámenie o výsledku verejného obstarávania), naming winning vendor, contract value and duration. Core evidence for who supplies ATMs, payment terminals, cash-handling, card personalisation and IT security to SK state bodies and state-owned banks/post.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled full-text/CPV-filtered search of the vestník; prefer bulk XML dumps where available, else paginated HTML scraping with polite rate limits.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from ÚVO site navigation
queries_used: ÚVO vestník verejného obstarávania bankomat platobný terminál zákazka
Slovakia public procurement open data API uvo.gov.sk otvorené dáta TED award notices

candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Vyhľadávanie zákaziek (tender search interface)
candidates.why_relevant: Primary query surface over notices; allows filtering by contracting authority, CPV code and status — the practical entry point for building a SK banking/payments tender corpus (CPV 30123400 ATMs, 30144200 ticket/payment machines, 66xxx financial services, 72xxx IT, 79132000 etc.).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Parameterised query harvesting by CPV + keyword, persisted as a delta crawl.
queries_used: ÚVO vestník verejného obstarávania bankomat platobný terminál zákazka

candidates.source_name: IS EPVO / EVO portal (evo.isepvo.sk) – electronic tendering system
candidates.why_relevant: The state's electronic procurement information system where tender documentation, clarifications and bid processes live. Tender documentation (súťažné podklady) reveals technical requirements, incumbent installed base, and integration constraints that award notices omit.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Public order-search crawl; download attached documentation packages for high-value banking/payments lots.
queries_used: ÚVO vestník verejného obstarávania bankomat platobný terminál zákazka

candidates.source_name: EKS – Elektronický kontraktačný systém / Elektronické trhovisko
candidates.why_relevant: Below-threshold marketplace for commonly available goods/services — where smaller but frequent banking/payments-adjacent buys land (terminals, card readers, cash counters, thermal paper rolls, service contracts). Contains executed contracts with supplier names and unit prices, so it exposes competitor pricing directly.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword search of concluded contracts (zmluvy) and orders; export price/quantity fields for pricing benchmarks.
queries_used: elektronické trhovisko EKS zákazka platobný systém banka

candidates.source_name: Centrálny register zmlúv (CRZ) – Central Register of Contracts
candidates.why_relevant: All contracts of ministries, central authorities and their subordinate bodies since 2011 must be published here to take effect (Act 546/2010). Gives full contract text — scope, SLA, term, renewal dates, price schedules — for banking/payments/ATM/IT-security deals, far richer than the award notice.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Full-text search by supplier IČO and by keywords; fetch PDF contract attachments and parse for value/term/renewal.
queries_used: Centrálny register zmlúv crz.gov.sk zmluva bankomat platobné terminály dodávateľ

candidates.source_name: zmluvy.gov.sk – aggregate contract listing of ministries and public institutions
candidates.why_relevant: Companion listing surface to CRZ covering the full set of ministries and public institutions; useful as a second index when CRZ search is limiting.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Secondary crawl; cross-check IDs against CRZ to avoid duplicates.
queries_used: Centrálny register zmlúv crz.gov.sk zmluva bankomat platobné terminály dodávateľ

candidates.source_name: Slovenská pošta, a.s. – verejné obstarávanie (buyer profile)
candidates.why_relevant: Slovenská pošta is a major SK cash-handling / counter-automation / postal-bank-adjacent buyer (Poštová banka relationship, cash desks, counter terminals, self-service). Its own procurement page carries calls, results and supplier contacts ahead of/alongside the vestník.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Page monitoring + link into its ÚVO profile for structured award data.
queries_used: Štátna pokladnica Slovenská pošta DataCentrum profil verejného obstarávateľa uvo.gov.sk

candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Profily verejných obstarávateľov (buyer profiles register)
candidates.why_relevant: Canonical index mapping each SK contracting authority (Štátna pokladnica, DataCentrum, Slovenská pošta, NBS-adjacent bodies, municipalities) to its published contracts and documents. The main snowballing device for building the buyer actor map for this cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off harvest of profile IDs for target buyers, then per-profile delta monitoring.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from buyer pages linking to their ÚVO profile
queries_used: Štátna pokladnica Slovenská pošta DataCentrum profil verejného obstarávateľa uvo.gov.sk

candidates.source_name: UVOstat.sk – procurement + contract register analytics aggregator
candidates.why_relevant: Re-indexes vestník, CRZ and RPVS into buyer↔supplier relationship views with per-company procurement histories. Fastest way to profile a competitor's SK public-sector footprint and spot repeat/renewal patterns without rebuilding the join yourself.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use for entity discovery and hypothesis generation; always confirm figures against ÚVO/CRZ primary records before reporting.
queries_used: uvostat.sk tendre.sk verejnesutaze.sk monitoring verejného obstarávania dodávatelia IT bezpečnosť banka

candidates.source_name: Verejnesutaze.sk – EPVO/EKS/UVO tender monitoring service
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial monitor that consolidates EPVO, EKS and ÚVO notices with filters and alerting; useful as an early-warning tripwire on new banking/payments lots and as a cross-check on coverage of our own crawl.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Register for keyword alerts rather than scraping; treat as pointer to primary ÚVO records.
queries_used: uvostat.sk tendre.sk verejnesutaze.sk monitoring verejného obstarávania dodávatelia IT bezpečnosť banka

candidates.source_name: uvozakazky.sk – public procurement monitoring
candidates.why_relevant: Another independent index of ÚVO zákazky; valuable as a redundancy check when ÚVO search is unstable or when historical notices have been reorganised.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/occasional cross-check only.
queries_used: uvostat.sk tendre.sk verejnesutaze.sk monitoring verejného obstarávania dodávatelia IT bezpečnosť banka

candidates.source_name: eZakazky.sk – electronic public procurement platform
candidates.why_relevant: Third-party e-procurement platform used by many SK authorities and by the electronic marketplace flow; hosts tender detail pages (documentation, deadlines, bidder communication) not always mirrored on ÚVO.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted fetch of tender detail pages referenced from ÚVO notices.
queries_used: ÚVO vestník verejného obstarávania bankomat platobný terminál zákazka
elektronické trhovisko EKS zákazka platobný systém banka

candidates.source_name: ERANET – procurement management system used by SK entities
candidates.why_relevant: Hosted tendering system used by utilities, state-owned and large private buyers (each buyer gets a sub-portal, e.g. zsdis.eranet.sk). Below-threshold and non-ZoVO procedures run here — including IT, security and payments services that never reach the vestník.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate buyer sub-portals of interest; monitor public tender lists.
queries_used: JOSEPHINE eranet ERANET.sk elektronické obstarávanie systém Slovensko banka zákazka

candidates.source_name: JOSEPHINE (Proebiz) e-tendering platform – SK instances
candidates.why_relevant: One of the two dominant SK e-tendering systems (with IS EPVO/ERANET); many contracting authorities run their banking/payments and IT lots here, with public tender lists and downloadable documentation. Referenced as a data source by SK procurement monitors.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Follow JOSEPHINE links contained in ÚVO notices rather than blind crawling; URL confidence is moderate — resolve via a notice link first.
candidates.discovered_via_method: named as a data source by SK procurement monitors (Transpera)
queries_used: JOSEPHINE eranet ERANET.sk elektronické obstarávanie systém Slovensko banka zákazka

candidates.source_name: Register partnerov verejného sektora (RPVS)
candidates.why_relevant: Any company contracting with the SK state above ~EUR 100k (250k recurring) must be registered with beneficial-ownership detail. Lets us confirm the legal entity, ownership and local partner structure behind a winning vendor — critical for distinguishing OEM vs local integrator/reseller in payments and ATM deals.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Lookup by IČO for each winning supplier extracted from ÚVO/CRZ; store verification documents.
queries_used: register partnerov verejného sektora rpvs.gov.sk vyhľadávanie dodávateľ štátu

candidates.source_name: data.gov.sk – Slovak open data portal (procurement datasets)
candidates.why_relevant: Reported to host daily XML dumps of procurement data (published since 2016) plus CRZ datasets — the bulk-ingest route that avoids fragile HTML scraping and enables historical trend/renewal-cycle analysis.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Locate the ÚVO/CRZ dataset entries in the catalogue and set up dated dump ingestion; validate schema before relying on it.
candidates.discovered_via_method: en-language search on SK procurement open data
queries_used: Slovakia public procurement open data API uvo.gov.sk otvorené dáta TED award notices

candidates.source_name: TED – Tenders Electronic Daily (Slovakia, above-threshold notices)
candidates.why_relevant: EU-level mirror of above-threshold SK notices in structured, multilingual, API-accessible form with stable CPV coding. Best channel for cross-country comparison of ATM/terminal/cash-handling awards and for catching SK notices in English.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: TED search API filtered country=SK plus CPV set for ATMs, payment terminals, banking services and IT security; note it misses the ~75% of SK contracts below EU thresholds.
queries_used: Slovakia public procurement open data API uvo.gov.sk otvorené dáta TED award notices

candidates.source_name: Transparency International Slovensko – public procurement monitoring / open tenders
candidates.why_relevant: NGO that builds derived datasets and case studies on the largest SK tenders, including IT contracts. Its analyses surface anomalies, incumbency and single-bidder patterns and often point to specific contracts worth pulling from ÚVO/CRZ.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Subscribe to publications; mine reports for named contracts, then verify at primary registers.
queries_used: uvostat.sk tendre.sk verejnesutaze.sk monitoring verejného obstarávania dodávatelia IT bezpečnosť banka

candidates.source_name: Transpera.sk – procurement and council-resolution monitoring
candidates.why_relevant: Monitors procurement across multiple SK platforms (explicitly including JOSEPHINE and ERANET) plus municipal council resolutions — the latter is the main way to catch municipal payments/cash projects before they become tenders.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Alerting/keyword subscription; use as a platform-coverage extender rather than a primary store.
queries_used: JOSEPHINE eranet ERANET.sk elektronické obstarávanie systém Slovensko banka zákazka

candidates.source_name: Protimonopolný úrad SR – guidance and decisions touching EKS/below-threshold procurement
candidates.why_relevant: Competition authority material on the electronic marketplace and bid-rigging in below-threshold contracts; indirectly reveals supplier clusters, cartel investigations and market-structure signals in SK public buying.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic review of decisions and guidance mentioning IT/payments suppliers.
queries_used: elektronické trhovisko EKS zákazka platobný systém banka

candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Aktuálne témy / methodology and registers hub
candidates.why_relevant: Hub listing every register ÚVO keeps under Act 343/2015 (registers of economic operators, bans, references). The register of references (register referencií) is especially useful: it records past performance of suppliers, i.e. de facto case-study evidence of installed base.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate registers, prioritise register referencií and register hospodárskych subjektov; harvest by supplier.
queries_used: ÚVO vestník verejného obstarávania bankomat platobný terminál zákazka

candidates.source_name: Slovenské elektrárne / large state-linked buyer procurement portals (PROEBIZ, ERANET)
candidates.why_relevant: Example of a large SK sectoral buyer running procurement on PROEBIZ/ERANET outside the vestník. Useful as a template for enumerating the non-ÚVO procurement channels of state-linked enterprises that buy card/payment and security IT services.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as a pattern; enumerate equivalent portals for banking-relevant state enterprises.
queries_used: JOSEPHINE eranet ERANET.sk elektronické obstarávanie systém Slovensko banka zákazka

negative_findings.description: Generic sk-language searches combining vestník/EKS terms with 'bankomat' and 'platobný terminál' returned portal homepages and methodology pages, not concrete award notices. Notice-level hits appear to require in-portal search (CPV/full-text) rather than general web search indexing.
negative_findings.result_summary: No specific SK ATM/payment-terminal award notice was retrieved via web search in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must assume in-portal querying (ÚVO search, EKS search, CRZ full-text) rather than relying on search-engine discovery; notice bodies are largely invisible to external crawlers.

negative_findings.description: Could not confirm dedicated buyer-profile URLs for Štátna pokladnica and DataCentrum (now largely absorbed into MIRRI/other bodies) in this pass; only the generic ÚVO profile-search mechanism and MIRRI's profile page were confirmed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Buyer-specific procurement profile URLs for Štátna pokladnica and DataCentrum not identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are named target buyers in the cell; their profile IDs must be resolved directly in the ÚVO profile register before monitoring can start.

negative_findings.description: The JOSEPHINE SK entry URL was inferred from the platform's known structure and from monitors naming it as a data source; it was not opened in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: JOSEPHINE listed with moderate confidence and no example URLs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents recording an unconfirmed URL as verified; the correct entry point should be resolved by following a JOSEPHINE link contained in an ÚVO notice.

negative_findings.description: Reporting indicates a large share of SK public contracts (~75% in 2025 per one secondary source) are not awarded via open calls, and only above-EU-threshold contracts reach TED.
negative_findings.result_summary: TED-only or open-call-only collection would systematically miss most SK activity.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Direct-award and below-threshold channels (EKS, CRZ, buyer portals) must be first-class collection targets, not fallbacks.

coverage_gaps.description: Municipal and self-government (VÚC, mestá/obce) contracting authorities buying payment/cash solutions were not enumerated; only national-level buyers were mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a target list of the largest SK municipalities and self-governing regions, resolve their ÚVO profiles and their eGovZmluvy/zmluvy.egov.sk contract registers.

coverage_gaps.description: No CPV code set has been fixed for this cell yet; keyword-only searching in Slovak is noisy ('terminál', 'karta', 'pošta' all have high false-positive rates).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define an explicit CPV allowlist (ATMs, cash-handling machines, payment terminals, banking services, IT security, card personalisation) and drive all portal queries from it, with keywords as a secondary net.

coverage_gaps.description: Bulk/structured access paths (ÚVO XML dumps on data.gov.sk, CRZ exports, TED API) were identified but their current schemas, endpoints and update cadence were not validated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a technical spike to confirm each bulk endpoint, its schema and history depth before committing to HTML scraping.

coverage_gaps.description: No SK procurement-review/appeal decision source was captured (ÚVO revízne postupy / rozhodnutia), which typically names losing bidders and disputed technical requirements.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and add the ÚVO decisions register (rozhodnutia ÚVO / námietky) as a distinct source — it is the richest source of competitor-vs-competitor evidence.

brief: Slovak public procurement is unusually well-instrumented for source scouting: a statutory journal (ÚVO vestník) plus the IS EPVO/EVO tendering system carry above- and standard-threshold notices, EKS carries below-threshold marketplace buys with unit prices, and the Central Register of Contracts (CRZ) publishes the actual contract text because publication is a condition of legal effect. Together these give named vendors, values, terms and renewal dates for ATM, payment-terminal, cash-handling and IT-security lots at state bodies, Slovenská pošta and municipalities, with RPVS resolving the beneficial ownership behind each winning entity. The practical constraint is discovery mechanics, not access: notice bodies are poorly indexed by web search, so collection must run in-portal by CPV plus Slovak keywords, and must not rely on TED, which only mirrors above-EU-threshold awards. Third-party layers (UVOstat, verejnesutaze.sk, Transpera, Transparency International Slovensko) are best used as tripwires and entity-discovery aids, with every figure re-verified against ÚVO/CRZ primaries.
